name: scroll-aware-header
title: Scroll aware header
description: A sticky header that hides on the way down and returns on the way up, or condenses, or turns solid, without trapping focus or shifting the page.
docs: Make it a direct child of the page or scroll area it should stick in. behavior="hide" slides away while scrolling down and returns on scroll up; condense shrinks its padding and gains a hairline; solid turns from transparent to solid. It never hides at the top, while anything inside it has focus, or while a menu in it is open (an element with aria-expanded="true"). Tabbing into a hidden header brings it back. Only transform animates for hide, and condensing trades padding for margin so the page below never moves. Set the padding with --rhs-header-py and --rhs-header-py-condensed. Scroll handling is passive and runs once per frame; reduced motion toggles instantly.
